lines.text: Many learners say: I have the same bag than you.
Better: I have the same bag as you.

data.wrong: I have the same bag than you.
data.right: I have the same bag as you.

quiz.stem: My phone is the same ___ yours.

native.tip: Le français dit « le même que ». En anglais, après “same”, on emploie “as”.
native.caption: Vous dites “I have the same bag than you.” ? Pour comparer deux choses identiques, dites “the same as”. Dites plutôt “I have the same bag as you.” — écoutez Carlos et répétez avec lui ! Plus d’exercices dans l’appli Lexkite.
native.comment: Réponse : “I have the same bag as you.” — Pour comparer deux choses identiques, dites “the same as”. Testez d’autres pièges avec un quiz gratuit : {link}

en.tip: French says “le même que”. English uses “the same as”.
en.caption: Do you say “I have the same bag than you.”? To compare two identical things, say “the same as”. Say “I have the same bag as you.” Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
